title: Subscription renews soon
description: Notify subscribers that their plan renews in a few days with amount and date. Utility renewal reminder template for SaaS.
notes: Annual renewals should be sent 7 to 14 days ahead; monthly ones 3 days. Link to manage plan for easy cancellation.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your {{plan}} subscription renews on *{{renewal_date}}* for {{amount}}. No action is needed. You can manage your plan any time.
